speech.heard: Over half of all nations generate less than a quarter of their electricity from renewables. The USA generates 20.3%. It counts power from renewable plants against total electricity generated. Which giant is the odd one out? India, Brazil, or China? India generates 19.1%. China has 28.4%. The answer is Brazil, with 77.4%. That is 4.1 times the renewable electricity India has. Bhutan generates 100 percent. Turkmenistan generates just 0.01 percent. What source makes the renewable electricity in your home?
